---
title: "rename_clusters"
output: html_document
date: "2026-06-29"
---

## Objective
Renumber the per-segment TreeCluster clusters so the number reflects **phylogenetic
position** instead of TreeCluster's traversal order. For each segment, clusters are ordered
by their **lowermost tip (min y) bottom -> top** in the rooted ML IQ-TREE and renumbered
`{SEG}-1 .. {SEG}-N` (bottom = 1). Singletons (`{SEG}-s`) pass through unchanged.

Why: TreeCluster's original numbering correlates only weakly/inconsistently with display
position (Spearman ~0.32-0.75 across segments), so the numbers carry no reliable
phylogenetic meaning. `max_clade` clusters are perfectly contiguous clades (contiguity=1),
so ordering by tip position is unambiguous.

Outputs (old -> new lookups + regenerated `tc_geno`/alias) feed the downstream metadata
build, which must be re-run with the renamed IDs.

# Setup
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
```

```{r}
# tc_geno concatenation order (must match existing metadata tc_geno)
seg.order<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA","M","NS")

tree.fold<-"../../../02_iqtree/iq_gtrfr10_rooted/"
genolook.fold<-"../../../01_fasttree/ft_rooted_outliers/2026-01-14_rem-outliers/rem_out/"
geno.in<-"../../../../data/08_clean-share/meta/metadata.csv"

today<-Sys.Date()
f.out<-paste0(today, "_rename_clusters_out/")
if(!dir.exists(f.out)){dir.create(f.out)}

geno<-read.csv(geno.in)
```

# Build per-segment old -> new lookups from IQ-TREE positions
```{r}
# Returns a lookup tibble: seg, old, new, min_y, mean_y, size
# Clusters ordered by lowermost tip (min y) ascending -> bottom of ladderized tree = 1.
compute_lookup<-function(seg){
  tree<-ape::read.tree(list.files(tree.fold, pattern=paste0("_",seg,"_"), full.names=TRUE))
  look<-read.csv(paste0(genolook.fold,"trim_nodup_nuc_",seg,"_rooted_resid.csv"))
  tc_col<-paste0("tc_cluster",seg)
  sing<-paste0(seg,"-s")

  # displayed (ladderized) tip y via ggtree -- same layout used in the figures
  yd<-ggtree(tree)$data %>% filter(isTip) %>% select(label,y)
  m<-yd %>%
    left_join(look %>% select(seq_new,sample), by=c("label"="seq_new")) %>%
    left_join(geno %>% select(sample,all_of(tc_col)), by="sample") %>%
    rename(cl=all_of(tc_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(cl))

  per<-m %>%
    filter(cl!=sing) %>%
    group_by(cl) %>%
    summarize(min_y=min(y), mean_y=mean(y), size=n(), .groups="drop") %>%
    arrange(min_y) %>%                              # bottom (low y) first
    mutate(new=paste0(seg,"-",row_number()))

  lookup<-per %>% transmute(seg=seg, old=cl, new=new, min_y, mean_y, size)
  # singleton bucket passes through unchanged
  if(any(m$cl==sing)){
    lookup<-bind_rows(lookup,
      tibble(seg=seg, old=sing, new=sing, min_y=NA_real_, mean_y=NA_real_, size=sum(m$cl==sing)))
  }
  cat(sprintf("%-4s clusters renumbered: %d | singletons(%s): %d | Spearman(old#,new#)=%.3f\n",
              seg, nrow(per), sing, sum(m$cl==sing),
              suppressWarnings(cor(as.numeric(sub(paste0(seg,"-"),"",per$cl)),
                                   seq_len(nrow(per)), method="spearman"))))
  lookup
}

lookups<-map(seg.order, compute_lookup)
names(lookups)<-seg.order
lookup_all<-bind_rows(lookups)

# write per-segment + combined lookups
walk(seg.order, ~write.csv(lookups[[.x]],
     paste0(f.out,"tc_cluster_rename_lookup_",.x,".csv"), row.names=FALSE))
write.csv(lookup_all, paste0(f.out,"tc_cluster_rename_lookup_all.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
```

# VALIDATION ONLY: apply lookups, regenerate tc_geno (reference, not authoritative)
# NOTE: the authoritative tc_geno / treecluster_genotype_alias rebuild belongs in the
# downstream 08_all-together metadata build, which applies the per-segment lookups above.
# This chunk only proves the relabel is a clean bijection and emits a reference map.
```{r}
remap_col<-function(old_vals, seg){
  lu<-lookups[[seg]]
  mapvec<-setNames(lu$new, lu$old)
  unname(mapvec[as.character(old_vals)])
}

ren<-geno %>% select(sample, tc_geno, treecluster_genotype_alias,
                     all_of(paste0("tc_cluster",seg.order)))
# new per-segment columns
for(seg in seg.order){
  ren[[paste0("tc_cluster",seg,"_new")]]<-remap_col(ren[[paste0("tc_cluster",seg)]], seg)
}
# regenerate tc_geno from the renamed columns, in seg.order
new_cols<-paste0("tc_cluster",seg.order,"_new")
ren$tc_geno_new<-apply(ren[,new_cols], 1, function(r){
  if(any(is.na(r))) return(NA_character_)
  paste(r, collapse="_")
})

# unmapped check (old numbered IDs present in metadata but absent from tree)
unmapped<-map_dfr(seg.order, function(seg){
  oc<-paste0("tc_cluster",seg); nc<-paste0("tc_cluster",seg,"_new")
  tibble(seg=seg,
         n_unmapped=sum(!is.na(ren[[oc]]) & is.na(ren[[nc]])))
})
cat("\nUnmapped (non-NA old, NA new) per segment:\n"); print(unmapped)
```

# Validate: relabel is a bijection, genome groupings preserved
```{r}
old_g<-ren$tc_geno[!is.na(ren$tc_geno)]
new_g<-ren$tc_geno_new[!is.na(ren$tc_geno_new)]
cat("Distinct tc_geno  old:", n_distinct(old_g), " new:", n_distinct(new_g), "\n")

pair<-ren %>% filter(!is.na(tc_geno) & !is.na(tc_geno_new)) %>%
  distinct(tc_geno, tc_geno_new)
cat("old->new is 1:1 ? ",
    n_distinct(pair$tc_geno)==nrow(pair) & n_distinct(pair$tc_geno_new)==nrow(pair), "\n")

# alias stays attached to the same genome group; just update its tc_geno string
alias_map<-ren %>% filter(!is.na(treecluster_genotype_alias)) %>%
  distinct(treecluster_genotype_alias, tc_geno, tc_geno_new) %>%
  arrange(treecluster_genotype_alias)
cat("alias rows (should equal n distinct alias):", nrow(alias_map),
    " distinct alias:", n_distinct(alias_map$treecluster_genotype_alias), "\n")
```

# Write outputs
```{r}
# AUTHORITATIVE artifact = the per-segment lookups written above
# (tc_cluster_rename_lookup_{SEG}.csv / _all.csv).

# Validation/reference outputs -> validation/ subfolder (NOT authoritative; the
# 08_all-together build is where tc_geno / alias are actually regenerated).
val.out<-paste0(f.out,"validation/")
if(!dir.exists(val.out)){dir.create(val.out)}
write.csv(ren,       paste0(val.out,"VALIDATION_tc_cluster_renamed_samples.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(pair,      paste0(val.out,"VALIDATION_tc_geno_rename_lookup.csv"),      row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(alias_map, paste0(val.out,"VALIDATION_tc_alias_rename.csv"),            row.names=FALSE)
```

# Sanity plot: new number increases bottom -> top
```{r}
# new index vs min_y should be perfectly monotonic by construction
plot.df<-lookup_all %>% filter(!is.na(min_y)) %>%
  mutate(new_num=as.numeric(sub(".*-","",new)))
ggplot(plot.df, aes(x=min_y, y=new_num))+
  geom_point(size=0.4)+
  facet_wrap(~seg, scales="free")+
  labs(x="Lowermost tip position (min y, bottom->top)", y="New cluster number")+
  theme_bw()
ggsave(paste0(f.out,"newnumber_vs_position.tiff"), width=8, height=6, units="in")
```
